name: Destin Library (Okaloosa County Cooperative)
notes: Premier coastal public library in Destin hosting author talks, tech classes, and children reading clubs.

name: Fort Walton Beach Public Library
notes: Main city library on Ferry Road hosting cultural exhibitions, literacy initiatives, and book sales.

name: Niceville Public Library
notes: Community library situated at the Niceville Civic Complex next to Partin Drive.

name: Crestview Public Library
notes: Hub of northern Okaloosa County hosting genealogy groups, youth gaming nights, and community art shows.

name: Mary Esther Public Library
notes: Neighborhood municipal library offering cozy reading circles and public computer access.

name: Valparaiso Community Library
notes: Overlooking Boggy Bayou, hosting waterfront storytimes and local history discussion groups.

notes: Destin city council, Harbor CRA executive meetings, and town hall community forums.

notes: Municipal governance, downtown development authority, and planning commission meetings.

notes: Crestview council chambers civic discussions and Main Street revitalisation meetings.

name: City of Niceville Council & Planning Commission
notes: Council proceedings and community development meetings at the Niceville Civic Center.

name: Mattie Kelly Arts Center (NWFSC Mainstage)
notes: State-of-the-art 1,650-seat performing arts theater hosting national touring shows and symphonic productions.

name: Mattie Kelly Cultural Arts Foundation (Destin)
notes: Destin Cultural Arts Village presenting Concerts in the Village and regional arts initiatives.

name: Stage Crafters Community Theatre
notes: Long-running volunteer community theatre troupe in downtown Fort Walton Beach.

name: Emerald Coast Theatre Company (Grand Boulevard)
notes: Professional equity and community theatrical productions, youth conservatory, and seasonal holiday shows.

name: HarborWalk Village Main Stage Concerts
notes: Waterfront stage featuring live rock, country, fireworks celebrations, and coastal street performers.

name: Fort Walton Beach Landing Downtown Concert Series
notes: Free community outdoor music series overlooking Santa Rosa Sound at the Landing park.

name: Crestview Warriors Hall Community Performances
notes: Civic auditorium hosting regional theatre tours, choral performances, and military band concerts.

name: Arts & Design Society (ADSO) Fort Walton Beach
notes: Fine art center offering gallery exhibitions, studio workshops in ceramics and stained glass, and community classes.

name: The Foster Gallery at Grand Boulevard (CAA)
notes: Rotating exhibitions showcasing Northwest Florida professional artists, sculptors, and mixed media creators.

name: Destin Artists Cooperative & Studio Gallery
notes: Local artist league workshops, plein air painting meetups along Destin harbor, and watercolor demonstrations.

name: Destin History & Fishing Museum
notes: Exhibits chronicling "The World Luckiest Fishing Village", antique rodeo rods, and early fishing families.

name: Heritage Museum of Northwest Florida (Valparaiso)
notes: Showcases indigenous Choctawhatchee artifacts, pioneer turpentine operations, and military history.

name: Camp Walton Schoolhouse & Indian Temple Mound Museum
notes: Heritage Park Cultural Center containing prehistoric mound, 1912 one-room schoolhouse, and Civil War museum.

name: Air Force Armament Museum (Eglin AFB)
notes: The only museum in the world dedicated to Air Force aviation armaments, missiles, and vintage warbirds.

name: Henderson Beach State Park (Destin)
notes: Preserves the last remaining undeveloped coastal scrub and coastal dune ecosystem in Destin.

name: Fred Gannon Rocky Bayou State Park (Niceville)
notes: Former WWII gunnery training site on Choctawhatchee Bay with cedar tree nature trails and kayak rentals.

name: Destin Harbor Boardwalk & Marler Park
notes: Bustling quarter-mile boardwalk offering fishing charters, dolphin watching cruises, and sunset vistas.

name: Turkey Creek Nature Trail & Boardwalk (Niceville)
notes: One-mile raised wooden boardwalk along clear, cool Turkey Creek with swimming platforms and picnic pavilions.

name: UWF Emerald Coast Campus Events (Fort Walton Beach)
notes: Branch campus connecting university researchers with the coastal defense community in Okaloosa.

name: Northwest Florida State College Public Lectures & Forums
notes: Niceville campus humanities series, leadership breakfasts, and community education workshops.

name: NWFSC Outdoor Amphitheater Programs
notes: Shaded pine glade lawn amphitheater hosting summer youth theater festivals and symphonic pop concerts.

name: AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar (Club Bimini Stage)
notes: Legendary harborfront open-air club featuring reggae, rock, and dance bands overlooking Destin Harbor.

name: The Block Fort Walton Beach (3 Clubs in One)
notes: Sprawling entertainment complex featuring country line dancing, rock band stage, and high-energy sports bar.

name: Boathouse Oyster Bar Live Music
notes: Rustic, Dollar-bill-lined harbor bar known for local singer-songwriters, fresh oysters, and craft beer.

name: Emerald Coast Science Center (Fort Walton Beach)
notes: Interactive science center featuring SMALLab interactive floor, robotic petting zoo, and makerspace labs.

name: Gulfarium Marine Adventure Park (Okaloosa Island)
notes: Historic 1955 marine park hosting educational dolphin presentations, sea lion exhibits, and stingray touch pools.

name: Wild Willy's Adventure Zone
notes: Island dinosaur adventure golf, 4D movie theater, urban ropes course, and family arcade.

name: Destin Seafood Festival (Destin Harbor)
notes: Historic festival celebrating Destin fishing fleet with 3 stages of music and local restaurant seafood stands.

name: Fort Walton Beach Downtown Farmers Market
notes: 2nd and 4th Saturday market at Fort Walton Beach Landing featuring regional farmers, cheeses, and smoked fish.

name: Destin Commons Farmers Market
notes: Outdoor pedestrian shopping village hosting Sunday morning farm-to-table food artisans and fresh produce.

notes: AFRL innovation hub supporting munitions and autonomous defense tech technology transfer and STEM education.

name: Eglin AFB Community Relations & Air Show
notes: Public demonstrations and community outreach by the 96th Test Wing at Eglin Air Force Base.

name: Hurlburt Field Air Commando Heritage Demonstrations
notes: 1st Special Operations Wing heritage airpark showcasing AC-130 gunships and special tactics demonstrations.

name: Okaloosa County STEMM Academy Innovation Nights
notes: Public student robotics demonstrations, coding hackathons, and aerospace design showcases.
